title: Two LCLI-677 round-2 notes: verification.toml's budget comment contradicts its own line, and cli-contract.md's growth widens three profile budgets
description:
Filed from the LCLI-677 round-2 review (opum-control review.recorded seq 8028, run job-0c9jdzx). Both were reported as MINOR, non-blocking notes on that landed change -- neither is a defect in it.

(1) CONTRADICTORY COMMENT. .lore/agents/verification.toml line 13 reads `max_tokens = 96400`, and the comment immediately above it (lines 10-12) ends: "No number is written here on purpose: it moves with every edit to a declared source, and `lore check` prints the current requirement when it is exceeded." A reader sees "no number" directly above a number. The intent is "no MEASURED value is written here on purpose" -- the budget is deliberately set above the measured set rather than pinned to it -- but the sentence does not say that. Suggest rewording to say the measured requirement is not written down (and is printed by `lore check` when exceeded), which is what the rest of the comment already explains.

(2) cli-contract IS PINNED BY THREE PROFILES. LCLI-677 grew docs/reference/cli-contract.md by adding 12 rows to the §2.1 kind registry. That document is PINNED by verification.toml, implementation.toml AND review.toml (each names reference/cli-contract in `pinned` or `sources`), so its growth widens ALL THREE profiles' declared-set sizes, not just verification's. LCLI-677 moved only verification's budget (96000 -> 96400) and left implementation's over-capacity warning in place -- it pre-existed, and the change widened its deficit from ~481 to ~1063 over the 108000 budget. review.toml's 63000 absorbed the growth with no finding. Worth deciding deliberately: whether the review and implementation budgets should move with a pinned-source edit, or whether a source pinned by three profiles argues for something else (a shared budget rule, or a warning the change's author is expected to resolve).

NOT STAMPED: no assignee; opum-doc decides whether it is dispatched.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The budget comment in .lore/agents/verification.toml no longer claims no number is written while max_tokens = 96400 sits directly below it; it says the MEASURED value is not written down and is printed by lore check when exceeded, which is what the rest of the comment already explains.
The cli-contract.md profile-budget policy question is filed separately as LCLI-702 rather than decided here.
